response.sql: WITH units AS (SELECT s.sentreg, s.instownpct AS ownership, t.ordertypedist AS order_type_mix FROM sentimentandfundamentals AS s JOIN transactionrecord AS t ON s.transref = t.transreg WHERE s.instownpct IS NOT NULL AND t.ordertypedist IS NOT NULL), baselines AS (SELECT ownership, AVG(ownership) OVER (PARTITION BY order_type_mix) AS mix_baseline, AVG(ownership) OVER () AS overall_average FROM units) SELECT AVG(ownership) AS average_ownership, AVG(ownership / NULLIF(mix_baseline, 0)) AS average_relative_to_mix, AVG(ownership - overall_average) AS average_excess_ownership FROM baselines WHERE ownership > overall_average
